payload.name: ExtractNamedEventTitles
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly names a specific piece, work, or performance in response to a question about a past event, use this Skill to ensure the named title is extracted as an event memory.
content: During extraction, when a speaker answers a question about what they performed, created, or won with a specific named title or piece, extract an event memory that includes the type of piece (e.g., dance piece, artwork, project), the exact title, and any stated context or result. Do not omit the candidate just because the answer is short or the title appears only once.

solves: During memory construction, named titles of pieces or works are sometimes omitted when a speaker explicitly names one in response to a question about a past event. This skill fixes extraction omissions by requiring an event candidate whenever a specific named title accompanies an accomplishment or event description. It applies to future sessions where a title is explicitly provided; it does not apply when only a style or category is mentioned.
